title.en: Send validated crypto payments directly to the wallet
title.zh: 加密付款校验后直接进入钱包

purpose.en: Remove the redundant browser confirmation using SmartLingo's localized checkout structure while preserving all payment safety checks.
purpose.zh: 按 SmartLingo 本地化结账结构移除重复浏览器确认，同时保留全部付款安全检查。

en: Proceed directly to wallet approval or payment after preflight.
Keep guidance inside the site translation helper.
zh: 预检通过后直接请求钱包授权或付款。
继续通过站点翻译函数提供说明。

en: Localized crypto checkout, safety tests, deployment, and Project history
zh: 本地化加密结账、安全测试、发布及 Project 历史

en: Remove localized window.confirm and USER_CANCELLED from ordinary payment.
Update localized direct-wallet guidance and preserve lookup, RefID, balances, gas, simulation, approvals, receipts, and reconciliation.
zh: 从普通付款中移除本地化 window.confirm 与 USER_CANCELLED。
更新本地化直达钱包说明，并保留查找、RefID、余额、Gas、模拟、授权、回执及核对。

en: Run zero-warning lint, SmartPay3 compilation, production build, complete multilingual tests, deployment gates, and production verification.
zh: 执行零警告 lint、SmartPay3 编译、生产构建、完整多语言测试、发布门禁及生产核验。

en: No real wallet transaction or purchase is executed.
zh: 本次不执行真实钱包交易或购买。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, language courses and prices, locale runtime, entitlements, authentication, data, media, and Cloudflare resources.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、语言课程与价格、语言运行层、权益、身份验证、数据、媒体及 Cloudflare 资源。
